input.context: This job runs on workflow_run and prepares a trusted PR event for Danger’s GitHubActions provider. GitHub reserves GITHUB_* workflow variables; the command needs a process-scoped assignment.

excerpts.text:
package-manager-cache: false
      - id: prepare
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9
        with:
          script: await require('./.github/gate/gate.cjs').prepare({github, context, core})
      - name: Danger from the default branch, PR data through the API
        id: danger
        if: steps.prepare.outputs.pr != ''
        env:
          DANGER_GITHUB_API_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GITHUB_EVENT_PATH: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.danger_event }}
        run: npx --yes "danger@$(node -p "require('./.devcontainer/agents/package.json').dependencies.danger")" ci --dangerfile dangerfile.js --failOnErrors

defects.claim: A workflow env assignment cannot override reserved GITHUB_EVENT_PATH, so Danger receives the workflow_run event instead of the prepared PR event.
